0022600178.text: The Memphis Grizzlies host the Indiana Pacers in their eighth game of the 2026-27 season, with Memphis at 6-1, 2nd in the Southwest division (0.5 games back) and 2nd in the West, after going 4-0 on the road and 2-1 at home. Indiana enters at 2-6, 3rd in the Central and 12th in the East, having lost five straight and gone 0-4 at home, and the Pacers are without Ben Sheppard, Ivica Zubac, Johnny Furphy, Obi Toppin, T.J. McConnell and Tyrese Haliburton, while Aaron Nesmith, Andrew Nembhard, Kelly Oubre Jr., Larry Nance Jr. and Pascal Siakam are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. Memphis is without Quinten Post and Scotty Pippen Jr., both listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, and the teams have not met yet this season, though the Grizzlies won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 125-106 in Indianapolis on March 1, 2026.
